description: This header file declares a factory function for creating a command handler related to device power button commands within the Cuttlefish Android project. It includes necessary dependencies and declares a function that returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler, which is associated with an InstanceManager.

methods.name: NewCvdDevicePowerBtnCommandHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler that manages device power button commands, utilizing an InstanceManager.
